positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a part of the Natural Language Processing Software Engineer team, my responsibilities include giving support to applications used by the NLP department, development of improvements for those applications and new development of applications for internal use and/or prototypes that will potentially make it into the NLP suite of apps.

Technologies used: Visual Studio, VS Code, PyCharm, .NET, Git, TFS, SQL Server, SQLite, MongoDB, RabbitMQ, Jenkins, Azure, AWS
Languages: Python, C#, JavaScript (Angular and React), and Java.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
A a software developer, I helped to update and migrate an ecosystem of Healthcare applications into the cloud as part of a 100+ team located in multiple timezones across the globe.

My responsibilities included translating functional and non-functional requirements from arquitects into user stories, working in an agile and highly collaborative environment, periodically function as a scrum master, developing (mostly back-end) code and unit tests, coordinate with QEs to test code, working in a continuous integration environment.

positions.title: .NET Developer
positions.description:
Give support and maintenance to mobile and web applications targeted at Public Housing Authorities. Responsibilities include troubleshooting, new requirements development, database management and deployment of updates to the client's machines.

Also, develop new web and mobile applications with Agile methodologies on TFS in collaboration with remote teams using the latest .NET technologies.

positions.title: Software Developer Internship
positions.description: Assisted on the development of an in-house application to replace a legacy system for the administration of training courses for employees. Used ASP.NET MVC 3, EF 4.1, razor and heavy use of jQuery to make it responsive and fast.

projects.title: AccountingMVC
projects.description: An Accounting Web Application developed using MVC5, EF6, nUnit, FluentValidation, Ninject and Automapper. Created with responsiveness and testability in mind.

projects.title: Housing Services
projects.description:
Replaces and merges multiple projects that as a whole handle the process of applying, selecting and managing accounts for thousands of applicants to Public Housing Services.
It interacts with a EAS and follows a simple onion architecture to share the core business logic and infrastructure between Projects and have a common UI presentation, Developed in ASP.NET MVC 5 using EF6, metro UI and jQuery.
